Obama inspires us to not lose faith and keep fighting for justice.

An important reminder today on Juneteenth that rights on paper are not enough if they are not enforced in practice. Freedom was declared in 1863, but many people remained enslaved until 1865. 

We still have much work to do to bend the moral arc of the universe towards justice.
